fact: The Ministry of Health's National Health Sector Policy 2021-2030 states that the health sector does not have in place a robust electronic medical record system, sets as strategy a full migration from paper-based recording at all levels with an Electronic Medical Record System section (5.3.4) calling for the ICT infrastructure to establish one, and describes the HMIS as paper registers and monthly return forms at the facility level with DHIS2 used at the regional health directorates and centrally.
title: National Health Sector Policy 2021-2030
publisher: Ministry of Health, Republic of The Gambia
